name: ideaForge SWITCH V2

atlas_legacy_record.note: Values below come from the live legacy atlas page captured on 2026-09-02 and were NOT independently verified in this upgrade pass. They are carried forward for continuity only and must not be cited as evidence.

what_it_is: The SWITCH V2 is ideaForge's next-generation fixed-wing hybrid-VTOL tactical ISR UAV, succeeding the SWITCH that won the Indian Army's largest mini-UAV contract. V2 upgrades target longer endurance, higher payload and simplified field operation for infantry units.
india_angle: ideaForge is the dominant Indian tactical-drone supplier to the Army; business media in 2025 reported ~$20M (about Rs 137 crore) emergency-procurement orders for high-altitude SWITCH variants, and later reports referenced SWITCH V2 alongside the ZOLT in Indian Army orders.
intelligence_assessment: Order-level reporting comes from business press and the company; unit counts for V2 specifically are not public. Watch ideaForge's quarterly disclosures - as a listed company its order book is auditable - for V2 adoption evidence.

faq.q: Is the SWITCH V2 in Indian Army service?
faq.a: ideaForge's SWITCH family is in Army service; V2-specific orders were referenced in 2025-26 reporting, with quantities undisclosed.

open_questions: Attach at least three independent, verifiable public sources (preferably MoD/PIB/OEM documents) to lift this entity to Tier B.
